WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.918865 39.651391)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

aspect_raster AS (

      ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(ST_Envelope(ST_Clip(rast, park_geom.geometry, TRUE))), 4326)
    ) AS aspect_angle_degrees
  FROM public.dem_us, park_geom
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, park_geom.geometry)
)
SELECT
  degrees(aspect_angle_degrees) AS terrain_aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_raster;
